name: Biển Hồ
kicker: Volcanic crater lake north of Pleiku
summary: Give Biển Hồ the first light. It is a freshwater crater lake about 7 km north of Pleiku, also called Hồ T’Nưng, and the provincial scenic list calls it a trace of three extinct volcanoes. Walk the shore. Skip it if you wanted a sea swim. Boat hire and tickets are Check on arrival.
getThere: About 7 km north of Pleiku, off Phạm Văn Đồng onto Tôn Đức Thắng
heroCaption: Hồ T’Nưng from the forested rim, with the water filling the frame

notice.title: This is a lake, not a beach
notice.body: Biển Hồ is freshwater, left by extinct volcanoes. Come for the shore and the mist. A sea swim is the wrong plan.

body: Turn off Phạm Văn Đồng, Quốc lộ 14, at the Biển Hồ junction and follow Tôn Đức Thắng to the water. The Gia Lai provincial portal puts the lake about 7 km north of Pleiku and calls it a trace of three extinct volcanoes. A half morning covers the shore and the viewpoints. If the light holds, the tea slopes are the same northern loop: about 12 km from town, left off Quốc lộ 14 onto Lê Văn Sỹ for about 3 km, then along the irrigation dam road. Stay off the harvest paths.

Come while mist is still on the water. Vietnam Tourism calls November to April the kinder months on these highland roads. Chu Đăng Ya, about 30 km northeast, is the other crater if the afternoon is dry. The English national tourism article puts that rim about 500 m above sea level. The Vietnamese walk-up names steep, slippery sections on the path from Ploi lagri village. The lake is the morning. The volcano is the longer ride.

figures.caption: The same lake from the pine shore
figures.alt: Pine trunks framing Biển Hồ, with the far forested shore across the water

gettingThere: The lake is north of Pleiku on the provincial scenic list. From the center, follow Phạm Văn Đồng, Quốc lộ 14, to the Biển Hồ junction, then Tôn Đức Thắng to the shore. The portal prints about 7 km. It does not print a minute count. The drive is Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Pleiku
legs.body: By taxi or ride-hail, then walk the shore. About 7 km north, with the turn from Phạm Văn Đồng onto Tôn Đức Thắng. Minutes and the fare are Check on arrival.

admissionNote: Boat hire and any shore ticket are Check on arrival. The Gia Lai provincial scenic list names the lake and the road. It does not print a price, a child rule, or what a ticket includes.
